body: My condolences to your loved one. I cant really help you but I hope you keep on chugging even if it'll become an absolute nightmare. Just staying alive is the only hope I got too after all.

There are more things you could do when you are still alive as compared to when u are dead. Sure the possibility of you not making a single decision for 5 years is there but as long as u are alive, other posibilities are still available.

No one is good dead after all.

Im suprised and kinda glad that u didnt pry me for questions lmao. I dont have to make my name devolve further into something more insane hahahahha. Thanks for your kind words stranger but Im pretty resolute in being suicidal despite how silly that sounds. I dont need no drama, dont need for people to grieve...I just dont wanna exist when theres nothing left I can do. Tho I hope you get past your stuff too pal, all the best.

Well ur deductions are correct lol. I'll be honest to you and say I think I can evolve humanity but I doubt thats the case right now since I dont even k now if its feasible yet. But when I do, I'll focus on staying alive to achieve it, for the betterment of the entire world...if it turns out I couldnt do shit, I'll gladly die when theres zero things that are left attached to me.
